test_scenarios.description: Verify agent follows the predefined first action instruction.

expected_behaviors: Agent initiates return/exchange request and performs the system-defined first action.

conversation.message: I want to return an item.

conversation.expected_behavior: Initiates the return/exchange process by asking for order ID.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent attempts to extract Order ID when not in state.

expected_behaviors: Agent attempts to extract Order ID from customer message.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent extracts phone number first if Order ID is missing and phone is present.

expected_behaviors: Agent extracts 10-digit phone number and fetches delivered orders.

conversation.message: I want to return an item. My number is 9876543210.

conversation.expected_behavior: Extracts phone number and then fetches orders.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent extracts and stores a 10-digit phone number first.

expected_behaviors: Agent extracts and stores the 10-digit phone number before any order fetching.

conversation.message: I need to initiate a return. My phone number is 1234567890.

conversation.expected_behavior: Stores the phone number and then proceeds with order lookup.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent retrieves order details after identifying the order.

expected_behaviors: Agent retrieves and uses order details after identifying the order.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Retrieves and confirms details for order GV12345.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent confirms the order is DELIVERED.

expected_behaviors: Agent confirms the order is delivered before proceeding.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent uses exact delivery date for grace period check.

expected_behaviors: Agent uses the exact delivery date from order details for grace period eligibility.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Checks grace period using the exact delivery date of GV12345.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent always asks for the reason before extracting it.

expected_behaviors: Agent explicitly asks for the reason for return/exchange.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Asks for the reason for the return.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent asks for video proof for exchange after reason.

expected_behaviors: Agent asks for video proof after collecting the reason for an exchange.

conversation.message: I want to exchange order GV12345 because it's the wrong size.

conversation.expected_behavior: Requests video proof of the issue.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent does not suggest exchange if customer explicitly wants it.

expected_behaviors: Agent does not suggest exchange when the customer explicitly states they want an exchange.

conversation.message: I want to exchange order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Proceeds with exchange process without suggesting it.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent provides final exchange instructions immediately after reason and video proof.

expected_behaviors: Agent immediately provides final exchange instructions after receiving reason and video proof.

conversation.message: I want to exchange order GV12345. The product is damaged. Here is the video: [video_link]

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent provides the exact configured return/exchange message.

expected_behaviors: Agent provides the exact configured return or exchange message.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345 because it's defective.

conversation.expected_behavior: Provides the exact configured return message.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent rejects returns/exchanges for undelivered orders.

expected_behaviors: Agent rejects return/exchange for an undelivered order.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12346, it hasn't arrived yet.

conversation.expected_behavior: Rejects the request as the order is not delivered.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent rejects requests outside the return/exchange grace period.

expected_behaviors: Agent rejects return/exchange for an order past its grace period.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345, it was delivered a month ago.

conversation.expected_behavior: Rejects the request as it's past the grace period.

test_scenarios.description: Verify agent stops process without mandatory confirmation or reason.

expected_behaviors: Agent stops the process if a reason is not provided.

conversation.message: I want to return order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Asks for the reason, does not proceed without it.
